notes: Box: Bay View Park, park roads drawn as two lines, park land, and hatched blocks whose sides face the park with no street between (the curved row along y 2900-3000 and the cross-hatched tract at the NE). Open land: one open seed; all park land is one area, its pieces joined through the road lines' ink, so no edge is labelled between pieces of park. Single lines in the park are not block edges and lie inside the open area: line from (4015,2668) to (4168,2790), the polygon (4180-4310, 2700-2845), the line from the circle (3762,2532) down to (3745,2600). BAY VIEW PARK lettering is part of the open land; the A of PARK encloses 31 px of paper at (4149,2731), which stays in the open area. Park roads: paper between two lines is street. Where three or four parallel lines run (loop at x 3740-3825, y 2420-2500; triangle road west side x 4010-4050, y 2560-2670) every strip between neighbouring lines is marked street (road beside a path, or a divided road: owner to rule). Ticks across roads at (3800,2486), (3855,2525), (3955,2490), (3990,2563), (4067,2607), (4210,2664) are left as printed. Limit (4050,2631)-(4032,2635): the strip between the lines at x 4031 and x 4045 ends where its east line stops at (4050,2631) and opens into park land. Strokes closing gaps in printed lines: (4032,2627-2636) and (4031,2652-2658) in the triangle road's middle line; (4236,2683)-(4242,2687) between the end of the tan road's east line and the circle road's north line; (4213,2633)-(4215,2664) along a faint (grey, below the threshold) printed line on the east side of the road from (4160,2600) to the circle. Road circles: the islands in the two circles (3762,2530) and (4263,2712) are left unseeded and so labelled street; the wedge between converging roads at (4206-4240, 2693-2707) is park (open). Long stroke: traced along the block side of the printed line that bounds the park, from (3794,3059) round the curved row to the tip of the park tongue at (4368,2784), points 4 px in from the park paper, checked at 4x and 10x; it crosses the street ends that this line closes. At (3914-3935, 3005-3019) a short printed line closes the street coming from (3936,3030) under a small diamond of park land: the stroke runs under that line, so the line and diamond stay park and blocks D (3880,3035) and F (3960,3020) are separated. NE cross-hatched tract has no outline toward the park: its edge is drawn as straight segments through the outermost hatch tips (4364,2786), (4340,2761), (4264,2673), (4244,2649), (4236,2633), (4202,2547), then along the outline of the lot block's south corner to the road at (4164,2598); half-open cells inside that line count as block. One block: the single-hatched lots (4150-4200, 2470-2570) and the cross-hatched tract (4140-4380, 2420-2800) print with continuous hatching at (4200-4230, 2530-2570), no line or street between, so they are one block. The street from (4200,2478) to (4345,2595), its stub ending in the hatching at (4321-4352, 2595-2633), and the north end of the road at (4150-4165, 2455-2485) are printed streets inside that block's outline (the leak check lists them; they are not leaks). The small hatched piece at (4350-4380, 2785-2825) at the park tongue's tip has hatching continuous with the tract and is part of that block. Corners that touch, separated by short strokes: block (4105,2470) with the road's outer line (4103,2512)-(4110,2522); the same block with the tract (4139,2445)-(4148,2455); blocks (4150,2995) and (4165,2945) at the end of the street between them (4203,3001)-(4213,3011). Block (4374,2586) is a corner cut by the box's east side.
